About

SC KATHMANDU · NEPAL

AI student. Technology enthusiast. Future builder.

I’m Sushil Chapagain, a B.Tech Artificial Intelligence student based in Kathmandu, Nepal. My interest lies in understanding how technology works and transforming ideas into meaningful digital experiences — exploring artificial intelligence, software development, web technologies, and interactive 3D environments while continuously developing my technical skills. I believe the future belongs to those who keep learning, experimenting, and building.

Principles

How I build — four rules I never break.

01

Learn by building

Theory matters, but testing ideas matters too. Each experiment is a chance to learn.

02

Design with feeling

Technology should feel human. Motion, colour and detail are not decoration — they are communication.

03

Performance is respect

Fast, smooth and accessible on every device — from a flagship phone to a budget laptop in Kathmandu.

04

Stay curious

AI keeps changing. Staying curious means trying ideas, asking questions and learning when an approach fails.

These principles shape everything on this page — from the subtle 3D card motion to a portrait that travels with the file.
